title: Senior L&D Manager
jobDescription: This is Worldline We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. The solutions our people build today power the growth of millions of businesses tomorrow. From your local coffee shop to unicorns and international banks. From San Francisco to Auckland. We are in every corner of the world, in every part of commerce. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution. The Opportunity As an international company undergoing a major transformation and experiencing rapid growth, we place significant emphasis on the growth and development of our people. In line with this, we are currently seeking a Project Manager-Learning Operation to join our team in India. In partnership with the Global People Development team (PDE), the candidate will play a crucial role in the establishment of a global learning competence center and the coordination of learning projects across the organization. You will collaborate closely with HR communities, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders to identify learning needs, develop learning solutions, and successfully implement these solutions within the company.
